normalization_rule: In every string value of the complete census report, replace a machine-specific absolute source or ANI resource root prefix (a value equal to a set root or beginning with the root followed by '/') with the stable identity ${X4_SET:<name>}. No other report data is altered. In this baseline the report stored only set-root-relative paths, so no absolute root prefixes occurred, the normalization was a verified no-op, and each normalized report is byte-identical to its raw report.
